scope: Exploratory engineering pilot for a synthetic one-sided jump-table fixture using one representative mutant from the bidirectional-jump behavior family; excluded from formal paired RQ1 results.

model.decoding_note: Use the Codex service default; the CLI does not expose a temperature override.

budget.candidate_unit: candidate files; each file may define exactly one top-level pytest test function
budget.attempt_policy: One generation call. Do not retry a structured response, including an empty candidate list.
budget.token_usage_policy: Record service-reported usage when available. If unavailable, store null and report the limitation.

validation.flakiness_rule: Reject a candidate if collection or any source-checkpoint execution fails, times out, or is unstable.
validation.correctness_rule: Retain only behavior directly specified by C1 with a documented oracle; this synthetic fixture is an isolated engineering probe, not an official benchmark suite.
validation.base_suite_rule: Preserve the complete sanitized C1 base suite unchanged and require it to pass with the generated candidate.
validation.guided_rule: Each retained candidate must fail by assertion on every declared same-checkpoint target survivor and pass unchanged C1 on every source repeat.

data_policy.additional_engineering_context: The opportunity brief describes only a synthetic SDE fixture derived for this probe; it contains no hidden, future, or regression data.
data_policy.hidden_and_future_data: never supplied to generation, mutation triage, or validation
